description: Details of one specific CVE by its ID (e.g., CVE-2021-44228). Returns the vulnerability description, CVSS score, severity, published/modified dates, weakness type (CWE), and reference links for fixes or advisories from the NIST National Vulnerability Database. (cost: 1 credit)

cve_id.description: string, required, the CVE identifier, e.g. "CVE-2021-44228"

name: cve_lookup
